resources.string: Search using root letters e.g f3l ...
Press back again to exit the app

Form I – فعل (fa3ala)
Form II – فعّل (fa33ala)
Form III – فاعل (faa3ala)
Form IV – أفعل (af3ala)
Form V – تفعّل (tafa33ala)
Form VI – تفاعل (tafaa3ala)
Form VII – انفعل (infa3ala)
Form VIII – افتعل (ifta3ala)
Form IX – افعلّ (if3alla)
Form X – استفعل (istaf3ala)

Double letters:
th / v / V = ث   gh / g / G = غ   kh / x / X = خ   sh / $ = ش   dh = ذ

Different cases:
d = د   D = ض   t = ت   T = ط   z = ز   Z = ظ   h = ه   H = ح   s = س   S = ص

All other letters:
a / A = ا   b / B = ب   j / J = ج   7 = ح   r / R = ر   e / E / 3 = ع   f / F = ف
q / Q = ق   k / K = ك   l / L = ل   m / M = م   n / N = ن   w / W = و   y / Y = ي

Separate letters:
Two-letter spellings always win, so shr is ش ر. To keep letters apart, put a hyphen or space between them: s-h-r is س ه ر.

To search for a word please click on the search icon (or tap once on a page) and enter the root letters of the word you would like to search for in Arabic or Roman Arabic. To navigate the dictionary, swipe left and right to turn pages. To zoom into the image pinch or double tap the screen and pan the image by swiping in the desired direction.

th, kh, sh, gh and dh stand for one letter each. If two of those letters really are separate (as in س‑ه‑ر), write them with a hyphen: s-h-r.

The whole dictionary is stored inside the app, so it works without an internet connection.

A pocket edition of the Hans Wehr Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic (4th edition) for students of Arabic: the scanned pages of the dictionary, with search by root letters.

Originally created by Uwais Iqbal. This version is maintained independently, is free of advertising and in-app purchases, and needs no network access.

Source code and updates: github.com/amjadodeh/Hans-Wehr-App
